svg.title: Visualizing Quantization
svg.desc: The same Charlie Chaplin portrait shown at 8-bit, 6-bit, 4-bit, and 2-bit grayscale precision. Visual differences remain subtle through 4-bit but become pronounced at 2-bit.
svg.text: The same 960 × 1189 grayscale portrait encoded with fewer bits per pixel.
8 → 6 → 4 bits: the representation shrinks while most structure survives.
At 2 bits, lost precision becomes obvious. LLM weight quantization follows the same trade-off—not the same pixel-by-pixel behavior.
